reports.desc: The dress purchased is a counterfeit of an image of another dress on another site. The dress I ordered had a raised brocade gold pattern. The dress received is a screen printed athletic pattern. When asked for a refund, told it was the same dress and they would offer a 15% discount as a gesture of good will however their site says full refunds with the exception the buyer pays shipping to China. Buyer beware!

I contacted the company to help me cosign a loan. They then had me sign a contract and pay the fee of $75 to get started. Once I signed the contract and paid the fee, I was blocked on their WhatsApp and Facebook group. I figured this out because I tried contacting them with no success.
Do not trust. Sends Korean booster packs worth much less. Claims 50% off and free gifts. But just bulk.

It was portrayed as being in Savannah, GA but product came from China via California address. I received merchandise but it wasn't as shown, took a month to receive, was very poor quality and didn't fit. Per the advertised money back guarantee, this was not the case. It was not returnable unless I paid additional money for each item and then no promise that it would be refunded to my account. I was told that I would be credited a 25% refund within 3-10 business days. That did not occur and my emails requesting credit have been ignored. This was ordered mid-July, didn't get order till mid-August and still no refund to my Credit Card.  I have attached the communication. They have only used stall tactics and now are not even replying to my request about the refund to my C Card so I am unsure of how to resolve this. Shocking that this could occur when it appeared so reputable.

I received an anonymous call about 6-7 times in less than a minute by 816 area code. I did not know who this person was. She called and her English was not very great and it was about a potential job opportunity and attempted to ask me basic questions to see if I qualify for the job then, after the questions I immediately was given an employee contract form asking about my personal information, my ID and mailing address in my account banking information.
